rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=24, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=1, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-19 (one knob vs iter-18 best). NUMBERS motion_range(n_bands24,n_outer1,thresh0): 8->hr0.0375, 4->0.0914, 2->0.1305(iter-18 BEST, RMSE0.004534 SSIM0.952) -- STRONG monotone hr climb as the motion search narrows; on dense 128-view breast data the true midpoint-view shift is ~sub-pixel so any excess span injects noise. FAILURE MODE: wide motion search = spurious-match noise in the densified residual; narrower is cleaner. ONE KNOB: wu_motion_range 4 already done -> now 2 -> 1 (narrowest non-zero; all else locked). HYPOTHESIS: if the optimal midpoint shift is ~0-1px, range=1 is the cleanest densification and hr rises above 0.1305; if range=1 is too restrictive to interpolate any genuine motion (hr down), the optimum brackets at 2 and iter-18 stands. Budget: cheapest yet, ~seconds.
